page.overview:
Who is Jeff?

Jeff is a major character in Into the Pit, the first story from Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit, and later makes a minor appearance in the Stitchwraith Stingers. In a constant state of exhaustion, Jeff is the owner and sole employee of Jeff's Pizza.

Jeff constantly looks tired and miserable with dark hair sticking up in weird places and alarming bags under his heavy-lidded, bloodshot eyes. He wears an apron stained with new and old tomato sauce. Oswald says Jeff looks about a hundred years old when he’s probably just thirty and compares his eyes, his apron, and his slow speech and movement to that of a “zombie pizza chef.”

In the video game adaptation, Jeff has darker skin and pale blue eyes. He's seen wearing a blue vest, an orange shirt, orange pants, and black shoes.

While Jeff is exhausted and speaks with a monotone voice, he is ultimately a nice man simply trying to run a business. While he does get upset to see Oswald having hid in the ball pit, his anger quickly fades and he returns to his usual self. In the game, he is a little bit dry and sarcastic, and seems suspicious of Oswald but still gives him keys to different rooms.
